text: 周四（10月1日）欧市尾盘，英国10年期国债收益率跌2.7个基点，报5.398%，整体呈现出M形走势，欧股盘初曾达到5.504%，逼近2007年三季度顶部5.564%、2000年一季度最高位5.899%、1998年一季度最高位6.307%。 两年期英债收益率跌8.6个基点，报4.801%，北京时间15:30也涨至4.970%（逼近9月14日顶部4.971%），随后持续下挫。 30年期英债收益率跌0.4个基点，报5.945%，15:37曾达到6.021%，为1998年一季度以来首次突破6%整数位心理关口；50年期英债收益率跌1.5个基点。 2/10年期英债
text_en: Thursday (October 1) late in the European session, the UK 10-year government bond yield fell 2.7 basis points to 5.398%, showing an overall M-shaped trend. Early in the European stock session it had reached 5.504%, approaching the third-quarter 2007 peak of 5.564%, the first-quarter 2000 high of 5.899%, and the first-quarter 1998 high of 6.307%. The 2-year UK gilt yield fell 8.6 basis points to 4.801%. At 15:30 Beijing time it had also risen to 4.970% (approaching the September 14 high of 4.971%), then continued to decline. The 30-year UK gilt yield fell 0.4 basis points to 5.945%.
